title: Test code and evidence boundaries
description: Begins with an everyday explanation, then traces test_the_summary_counts_the_rows_and_the_partitions in tests/test_pipeline.py. Source units combined: Test code and evidence boundaries.

learning_objectives.text: Explain test code and evidence boundaries in plain language using the project source.
Trace `test_the_summary_counts_the_rows_and_the_partitions` in `tests/test_pipeline.py` and explain its inputs, behavior, and output.
Use a test or boundary case to assess what the implementation proves and what remains unverified.

practical_outcomes: Explain one data or control boundary.
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and the source exercise.
Answer ten module questions using lesson evidence.
Distinguish actual code behavior from assumptions and proposed extensions.
